title: Cats and Cats
description: This mod aims to add a meowy challenge to Minecraft survival and allow you to do things like have a personal friend or fight off the evil corruptions.
body: Explore a world of new cats that can go from friendly to scary as you enter a world of new wonders. In this mod you can find cats that range from strong to weak, have been corrupted, or even turned into ore! This mod aims to add a challenging experience to Minecraft and to add a new meowy wonder with _Cats and Cats_, or what you may recall, _Wonderful Wat Cats_.
